sources.description: April 13, 2026 - Local coverage of the Raytheon building fire in Warner Robins, Georgia. Firefighters responded at 1:00 a.m., smoke from front windows, investigation underway by Warner Robins Fire and Police Departments.
sources.label: WGXA - Investigation underway after overnight fire at Raytheon building in Warner Robins

sources.description: April 13, 2026 - Additional coverage of the Raytheon building fire. Confirms 1:00 a.m. response, building cleared, crews on scene until 4:00 a.m.
sources.label: NewsBreak - Investigation underway after overnight fire at Raytheon building in Warner Robins

sources.description: Robins Air Force Base fact sheet showing Raytheon as major mission partner with $369.9M in contracts. The Warner Robins Air Logistic Complex is the largest single-site industrial complex in Georgia.
sources.label: Robins Air Force Base - Mission Partners and Economic Impact
